name: Priority: Critical
description: Issue has critical impact on breaking changes and must be implemented at once.

name: Priority: High
description: Issue has high impact on changes and will be implemented before reaching breaking point.

name: Priority: Medium
description: Issue has medium impact on changes and needs to be implemented in parallel.

name: Priority: Low
description: Issue has low impact on changes and can be implemented on normal schedule.

name: Status: Open
description: Issue is open and needs to be reviewed.

name: Status: Resolved
description: Issue is resolved and will be released on next commit.

name: Status: Abandoned
description: Issue is abandoned after being worked on due to a reason.

name: Status: Delayed
description: Issue is delayed due to a reason.

name: Status: Closed
description: Issue is closed and won't be worked on due to a reason.

name: Type: Generic Issue
description: Issue has been created with generic purpose.

name: Type: Bug Report
description: Issue has been created or serves as a report of a bug.

name: Type: Documentation Revision
description: Issue has been created or serves as a revision of documentation.

name: Type: Feature Request
description: Issue has been created or serves as a request for a feature.
